text.trigger: A player has just used the ability of a weapon item card.
text.vignette: The shot lands and the zombie drops, and you reach for the next clip only to find your pocket empty. For a long moment you stare at the barrel and think of everything the gun cannot do now.

options.bin-the-weapon: Throw the empty weapon away: the weapon whose ability was just used goes to the waste pile.
options.hunt-for-ammunition: Scour for more rounds: move all your unused action dice to used.
